title: The optimized uniform squeeze gives an explicit ground-energy limsup and a vacuum-instability threshold

optimized_upper.threshold: A squeezed member beats the vacuum coefficient iff g>g_c:=c_Omega/(24c_C^2), approximately 0.0141310864; for 0<g<=g_c the vacuum minimizes this one-parameter family
optimized_upper.interior_minimizer: For g>g_c, the unique interior minimizer is s_g=[c_Omega+sqrt(c_Omega^2+192g c_C^2 c_Omega)]/(96g c_C^2), equivalently 48g c_C^2 s_g^2=c_Omega(s_g+1)
optimized_upper.optimized_coefficient: For g>g_c the minimum is h_g=c_Omega(s_g^2-3s_g+4)/(8s_g)<6g c_C^2; for g<=g_c it is h_g=6g c_C^2
optimized_upper.limsup: The unrestricted cutoff ground energy obeys limsup_(N to infinity) E_N/N^4<=min_(0<s<=1)e_g(s), with strict inequality below 6g c_C^2 when g>g_c
optimized_upper.composition: Together with K1557 this gives a positive finite quartic coefficient corridor but no matching lower coefficient or convergence of E_N/N^4
optimized_upper.scope_guard: The threshold is a variational statement inside an explicit Gaussian trial family and a strict unrestricted upper bound relative to the vacuum when it fires; it is not a phase transition of the full theory, a leading asymptotic theorem, localization, compactness or Mosco recovery
